_comment: The painted map's colours. Resource packs can replace this file; F3+T reloads it. Every value is optional: one left out or unreadable keeps the built-in value. Classes are the surface classes 0-7: grass, forest floor, sand, rock, snow, dirt/mud, ice, lava. 'tint' is how much the biome's grass or foliage colour tints the class (0 none, 1 fully). Distances are in blocks.
_water: deep_at: depth at which water is fully deep; deep_dist: distance from the shore at which it is; shore: the pale band along the shore, shore_width blocks wide
_edges: softness: how soft the border between two surface classes is (0.01 sharp, 1 a wide blend); warp: how far, in blocks, borders and coasts wander from the data
_forest: darken: how much full canopy darkens the ground; stipple: strength of the soft brush texture over forests
_contours: only drawn when contours are switched on in the map (off by default); interval in blocks of height
_finish: grain: paper grain over the whole map; vignette: how much the corners of the fullscreen map darken
_fog: the fog over unexplored land: colour (paper a shade darker by default), edge: how far, in blocks, the explored land fades into it (8-256), clouds: how strong the static cloud texture in it is, and how much it roughens the edge (0-1)
